messages.content: I want to buy apples, rice, and 12 pack of bottled water from a Walmart near San Jose. Show me the product information and stock availability.

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

We need to call the function walmart_purchase with loc "San Jose" or "near San Jose". Items: apples, rice, bottled water. For bottled water, pack size 12. So product_list: ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"]. pack_size: [undefined?], but we need array same length. For apples and rice, no pack size. We can set pack_size: [null, null, 12] or maybe 0. The function signature: pack_size?: number[]. So we can provide pack_size: [null, null, 12] but type expects number[]. Null not number. Maybe we can provide [0,0,12] or [1,1,12] but 1 might mean 1 pack. But for apples and rice, we don't need pack size. We can just omit pack_size. But the array length must equal product_list. The doc says "The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified." So we can omit pack_size entirely. But we need to specify 12 pack of bottled water. How to indicate pack size? Maybe we can include pack_size: [12] but array length mismatch. So maybe we need to include pack_size: [12] and product_list: ["bottled water"]? But we also need apples and rice. Hmm.

Maybe we can pass pack_size: [12] and product_list: ["bottled water"]? But then we miss apples and rice. The function expects product_list array. So we need to include all items. For apples and rice, we can set pack_size: [0,0,12] or [1,1,12]. But 0 might be invalid. But we can set pack_size: [1,1,12] meaning 1 pack each. That might be okay. Let's do that.

Thus call:

{
  loc: "San Jose",
  product_list: ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"],
  pack_size: [1,1,12]
}

Let's call function.
